BiblicalUsage: Chaniynah appears once, in God's sentence on a people who served other gods: there will I not show you favour.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word cuts deepest because it is the absence of grace: a people told plainly that favour is withheld.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
